breadcrumb.name: Payroll services: Why should you outsource them?

contentHtml:
Without a doubt, payroll is one of the main aspects of any business. It is the driving force behind the productivity and efficiency of its employees. However, it is also an area of an organization that must be conducted following the laws of the UAE. Noways, payroll outsourcing in Dubai has become a common practice among businesses.

In this article, you will learn everything about payroll outsourcing in Dubai. There is a stigma associated with payroll as a simple non-core function that is taken lightly because it does not directly generate revenue. Knowing why payroll is important and believing in it as an influential part of a business can help you use those reasons to your advantage. Let us observe:

1. The United Arab Emirates and its outsourcing industry

2. What is outsourcing?

3. How can an organization benefit from outsourcing payroll services?

4. Things to consider before implementing in-house payroll services in the UAE

5. The benefits of payroll outsourcing

6.  How can Connect Group help you?

1. The United Arab Emirates and its outsourcing industry

In Dubai alone, there are numerous payroll services. Companies such as small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) typically outsource.  This means that there are a plethora of payroll services in the UAE from which business owners can benefit.

Entrusting this function to an outsourced company is an understandable step to take for startups that are focused on expanding their business.

Connect Group is an experienced company that can perfectly help you with your outsourcing. Contact us for getting more information today.

2. What is outsourcing?

Outsourcing is simply paying someone or a company to perform certain functions of your business that you do not have time to do. Payroll, accounting firms, HR outsourcing services, PRO, are functions that you can outsource.

This type of practice is common among startups and SMEs. This is due to a lack of time or staff to handle the aforementioned areas of a company.

3. How can an organization benefit from outsourcing payroll services?

The accuracy of paychecks is critical because every company should pay employees based on their abilities; hence, this should be done flawlessly. Not only should the accuracy be maintained, but so should the deductions and other salary calculations.

It is a very complex situation because if you are dealing with the payroll department; you must be aware of the current laws governing wages and salaries, as well as keep up to date on any changes.

In addition, firms with in-house payroll services face numerous other challenges. This may result in penalties and fines that increase the burden on both employees and the organization.

3.1. Example

For instance, consider a company that manufactures cars, and pays its employees monthly.  It pays extra wages to employees who work overtime. Additionally, it has an in-house payroll service that is experiencing problems such as a shortage of professionals who are experts in calculating paychecks.

In addition to this, they are also unaware of changes in the government’s tax policies and policies regarding the welfare of the nation. So, it has resulted in massive consequences. Is not it terrifying to consider a company with disorganized payroll services? To avoid these types of situations, most businesses prefer to outsource payroll services.

This is because it simplifies their work and relieves them of the burden of timely payment and paycheck accuracy. By outsourcing a payroll service, the company can credit wages and salaries according to the working hours of the employees and workers. Plus, they will not have to worry about penalties in the future.

3.2. Motivation

In addition, the firm can concentrate on other core activities that require more focus and concentration. Furthermore, it is critical to maintain good relationships with workers and employees. This is because human resources are one of the most valuable assets that a company can have.

So, to satisfy them, every company may have some special incentives that boost their morale. Therefore, outsourcing the payroll service may timely provide those incentives without any delay that may motivate them. As a result, they will work hard to achieve the firm’s objectives.

4. Things to consider before implementing in-house payroll services in the UAE

The company must be aware of the existing wage law in the country. It states that remuneration provided to employees must cover their basic needs and assist them in surviving. So, it is necessary to assess whether the paychecks provided are sufficient for the worker’s survival. However, if not, there may be other consequences, such as unsatisfied employees contacting the MoHRE in UAE and filing a complaint about unpaid and delayed salaries.

Another important point to emphasize is that employers registered with MoHRE should also register with the Wages Protection System. It requires employers to deposit salaries or wages directly to banks or financial institutions recognized by the UAE’s central bank. If they do not, the company will face severe penalties from the UAE government.

Furthermore, they may be barred from registering with any new company and denied a work permit. As a result, the company may be demoted to the lowest level. On the other hand, if you work without a work permit, there will be legal consequences.

4.1. Other details

A company may hire more than 50 workers who are paid less than AED 2000 per month. In this case, the company is obligated to provide adequate food and lodging for the workers; if they fail to do so, it will have far-reaching consequences.

If the firm has decided to purchase the employee the new insurance policy; this was approved by the UAE cabinet, so the amount of insurance must be deducted from the employee’s salary. Otherwise, the insurance policy may be null and void.

The above are some of the policies and laws that a company must follow in the UAE when performing payroll services. It turns out to be very sophisticated for a company to focus on all of these activities. Additionally, it will have to create a separate department to deal with paychecks and salary payments, which could cost a lot of money.

After considering the consequences, it is prudent to use payroll outsourcing services. This is because they can provide an accurate result with efficient working, thereby avoiding the various consequences mentioned above.

5. The benefits of payroll outsourcing

Outsourcing payroll has numerous advantages. Let us go over a few of them:

5.1. It saves you time

One of the most significant benefits of payroll outsourcing in Dubai is time savings. Payroll outsourcing allows the company’s employees to save a significant amount of time. This may allow them to focus on other functions, potentially increasing the company’s revenue.

Payroll is a time-consuming process. It requires not only time but also attention. A minor error can cause a slew of issues. This is why the person in charge of the payroll process must pay attention to every detail. If a small business spends the majority of its time on payroll processing, it will fall behind in performing other critical functions.

This would harm the company’s critical tasks. As a result, third-party firms require their employees to work solely on the payroll functions of their clients. They are committed to completing such tasks on a full-time basis and excel at doing so without error.

5.2. Avoid penalties

If the company fails to manage the payroll function properly, it may face a variety of penalties. You should carry out payroll activities regularly following tax regulations.

It is not uncommon for businesses to be unaware of changes and updates to government rules and regulations. Companies may face a variety of penalties as a result of this. Payroll outsourcing in Dubai saves businesses from having to deal with such a problem.

This is because payroll service providers, such as our firm, are always up to date on all changes, saving businesses from penalties.

Small businesses in the early stages of development can suffer greatly as a result of tax penalties. Such losses are unsustainable for small businesses. Hiring accountants for accounting tasks can save small businesses money while also creating a positive image in the market.

5.3. You will get an error-free service

When you use third-party service providers, they will reduce errors. It improves work efficiency while also assisting the company in establishing a good reputation in the market.

On the other hand, we offer effective visa services. Thus, with us, you can get an investor visa, a golden visa, a remote work visa, a freelance visa, among others.

5.4. Security

Data security is a major concern for businesses, and there is a risk of theft if in-house employees handle payroll functions. To avoid such risks, businesses should seek assistance from third-party payroll service providers.

As a result of the data being kept in safe zones, the company’s data is kept in safer hands. Furthermore, payroll outsourcing companies ensure data security by developing separate systems for it.

5.5. Money saving

Payroll processing can be very expensive for a small business. Hiring separate employees for such a large task; as well as providing them with extra office space and resources, could all cost the company a lot of money.

If there are no outsourcing companies in the UAE, small businesses may be unable to support such a function. Companies that outsource their payroll functions may save more money than they would if they did it in-house. When you choose outsourcing, you will get guaranteed cost savings.

5.6. Professional payroll consultant expertise

We are aware that professionals are more knowledgeable. They know how to handle specific situations properly. When the work is in the hands of professionals, the chances of mistakes are also very low.

Professional payroll service providers are well-versed in all aspects of payroll. They are experts in all aspects of payroll taxes and other government regulations. As a result, they are better at producing high-quality work in a short period.

5.7. Reliability

If a company outsources its payroll to a third-party payroll service provider, it has nothing to worry about. There is no chance of losing the resources, just as there is no chance of losing the data.

5.8. Paperless

Another significant benefit of payroll outsourcing in Dubai is that the company does not require paper-based procedures because electronic methods are used.

5.9. Infrastructure

Quality payroll service providers will have access to cutting-edge technology and HR software. This will allow them to process payroll efficiently without incurring the expense of purchasing and maintaining an in-house system; as well as the associated hardware.

5.10. Confidentiality

Unauthorized individuals may gain access to data stored on an in-house server. Outsourcing the payroll function reduces the risk of sensitive information leakage, employee identity theft, and potential misuse of company funds.

On the other hand, we offer outstanding company formation services. Hence, we can assist you in setting up a business in a Dubai Free Zone such as JAFZA and RAKEZ.

6. How can Connect Group help you?

Even if it is not a revenue-generating function in a business, it motivates those who generate revenue in your organization. When someone handles payroll properly, it can give the impression of a company’s stability. Now you are aware of the advantages of payroll outsourcing in Dubai.

Therefore, we are here to assist you in the best way possible with your ultimate payroll services. All you have to do is contact us and hand over your entire burden to us. Payroll outsourcing has never been so simple for anyone. Hire us and worry less about such an important function of your business.
